task: Predict in-hospital death from measurements in [0, 48 h) for all 12,000 released ICU stays
bp_merge_policy: Per window, prefer the invasive arterial stream when that window has at least one invasive reading; otherwise use the non-invasive cuff stream. Derived streams are additive: the six source parameters keep their own unchanged columns, and merged streams do not count toward record-level distinct/total observation counters.
derived_static_policy: static_bmi = static_admission_weight_kg / (static_height_cm / 100)^2, missing when either input is missing or height is non-positive.
imputation: Training-split median; all-missing-in-train columns use 0 and are flagged
scaling: None; model-specific scaling must be fit inside training data later
duplicate_policy: Audit exact duplicates/conflicts; collapse same-time dynamic continuous values by median, MechVent by maximum, and Urine by sum before longitudinal summaries
outlier_policy: Values outside preprocess.PHYSIOLOGICAL_RANGES are set to missing (not clipped); pH > 14 is divided by 100 and Height < 100 cm is multiplied by 100 before the range check
